title: Natura's $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
key_facts: Natura, an AI and hardware startup, announced Interface, a $99 smart ring for working with AI agents and tracking health.
Users can ask an agent to do a task, capture thoughts and control devices; replies come via connected headphones, an iPhone Live Activity or the NatureOS app.
At launch it connects to agents and apps including Meta's Muse, Instinct, Grok Bot, Claude and ChatGPT.
Preorders are expected to open next month, with shipping in December or January.
After a free period of three to six months, Natura plans a $9 monthly subscription and eventually a higher ring price.
It tracks heart rate, HRV, sleep stages, steps and skin temperature; battery lasts six to 12 days.
Founder Carlo Edoardo Ferraris, who founded Rolling Square, predicts most people will have a personal AI agent within about a year.
quote_evidence: Meet Interface, a new $99 smart ring from AI and hardware startup Natura that’s designed for the era of AI agents.
Preorders are expected to open next month, with shipping slated for December or January.
why_it_matters_hint: Wearable voice access to AI agents, still a pre-launch product with the founder's own forecasts.
notes: Product not yet shipping; battery, price and market claims are the company's. Ferraris's forecast of a personal agent for most people within a year is his opinion.
